Moves in with Nelly McDougal and Mickey Culzean November 35 Meets William Hare, moves in to his house with Nelly 1827 Hare’s lodger, Donald, dies; Burke and Hare sell deceased body to Dr. Knox to 11-29-1827 35 cover debt owed by Donald. Sold for ₤7 10 shillings February Hare’s lodger, Joseph, falls ill; Burke and Hare smother him with a pillow, sell his 36 1828 body to Dr. Knox for ₤10. Went out drinking with Abagail Simpson; she returned to Hare’s home because 02-11-1828 36 she was sick from drinking, Hare and Burke smother her. Sold to Dr. Knox for ₤10. Burke, while drinking, meets two prostitutes; buys them more alcohol, takes them 04-09-1828 36 back to his brother’s house. One prostitute, Mary Paterson, passes out on the dining table; Burke and Hare smother her. Body sold to Dr. Knox for ₤8. A woman lodger, at Hare’s home for one night, is very drunk; Burke smothers her
and the body is sold to Dr. Knox for ₤10. Mary Haldane, a lodger, falls asleep in Hare’s stable; Burke and Hare suffocate
her, sell her body to Dr. Knox. Effie comes to Hare’s house, Burke takes her to the stable and gets her drunk;
Burke and Hare suffocate her, sell the body to Dr. Knox for ₤10.

Burke takes a drunken woman, who is being escorted home by an officer, off the officer’s hands. The woman is killed, and her body is sold to Dr. Knox for ₤10. “Midsummer, Old woman and her grandson from Glasgow lodge at Hare’s home; Burke and 36 1828” Hare smother them and sell their bodies to Dr. Knox for ₤8 each. Burke and Nelly move two streets away, in to an apartment with Burke’s cousin
and her husband, the Broggans. Margaret Haldane, daughter of Mary Haldane, suffocated at the Broggan’s by

Burke; body sold to Dr. Knox for ₤8. September Mrs Ostler, a washer, comes to the Broggan’s. Burke and Hare get her drunk, then 36 1828 suffocate her. Body sold to Dr. Knox for ₤8. Autumn, Ann McDougal comes to visit Nelly at the Broggan’s; Hare and Burke get her 36 1828 drunk, then kill her. Body sold to Dr. Knox for ₤10. Jamie Wilson, who is mentally retarded, is invited to Hare’s home by Hare’s October, 36 girlfriend, Maggie Laird; Wilson drinks some, and Burke and Hare suffocate him. 1828 They strip his body, taking a spoon and snuff box. Body sold to Dr. Knox for ₤10. Mrs. Docherty lured back to Burke’s; killed after the Halloween party by Burke 10-31-1828 36 and Hare. The struggle is heard by many of Burke’s neighbors. James Gray, neighbor of Burke, goes to the police after his wife discovers the 11-01-1828 36 corpse of Mrs. Docherty. Nelly and Burke are taken in for questioning. Police discover the corpse of Mrs. Docherty in Dr. Knox’s basement. The body 11-02-1828 36 was identified by neighbors of Burke; Burke, Hare, Nelly and Maggie are charged with murder. Hare and his wife Maggie offered immunity if Hare comes forward about Mrs. 12-01-1828 36 Docherty and any other of Burke’s murders. Burke was set for trial on two counts of murder. 12-24-1828 36 Trial begins Burke found guilty on majority vote (two members voted not guilty) and Nelly is 12-25-1828 36 found not guilty. Burke sentenced to hanging on January 28, 1829, and his body to then be dissected. Burke is hanged publicly. His body is then dissected publicly, in accordance with 01-28-1829 37 a law from 1752.
